questions.text: What are the contribution of the Kadambas to the culture of Karnataka and India?
questions.text_as_printed: What are the contribution of the Kadambas to the culture of Karnataka and India? (A)

answer.value:
Contributions of Kadamba to Indian Culture:
The Kadambas made distinctive contributions to Indian culture.
They established an efficient administrative system, promoted religious harmony, and contributed to the field of literature, art, and architecture.
The ancient Halmidi inscription in Kannada dates to this period.
They maintained an excellent education system, with agraharas serving as educational centers.
Governors, priests, ministers, and military commanders played key roles in administration.
The kingdom was divided into provinces, with provincial officers appointed to manage them.

questions.text: The society during Gangas was influenced by many values. Justify the statement
questions.text_as_printed: The society during Gangas was influenced by many values. Justify the statement (D)

answer.value:
Ganga Society:
Ganga society gave importance to valued truthfulness, loyalty, bravery, and patience.
Despite various castes and communities, society was interdependent.
The patriarchal joint family system was prevalent.
Young warriors and officials were renowned for their courage and patience.
These values enabled effective governance.

questions.text_as_printed: Explain the achievements of the Satavahanas in the field of art. (A)

answer.value:
During the Satavahana period, the paintings of Ajanta and Amaravati were created.
Temples, viharas, and chaityalayas were constructed.
The chaityalaya at Karle was built by a wealthy patron (Bhupala) of Banavasi.
